paper.title: Transformer Autoencoder-Assisted Evolutionary Framework for Constrained Multiobjective 3D Wind Farm Layout Optimization

kernel_scope: mathematically trainable Transformer autoencoder kernel only

declared_missing_field_completions.encoder_sequence_pooling: fixed-order arithmetic mean over encoder sequence positions before latent projection
declared_missing_field_completions.embedding_ownership: separate encoder and decoder token and position embeddings; BOS is decoder-owned
declared_missing_field_completions.generic_layout_corpus: exactly sequence_length unique vocabulary cells in canonical ascending order
declared_missing_field_completions.problem_monitor_exclusions: deferred to the blocked end-to-end M3 problem binding

paper_scale_pretraining.batch_order: deterministic Fisher-Yates shuffle from batch_seed for each epoch

losses.metric_alignment: mean_squared_alignment_of_L2_normalized_latent_distance_and_absolute_relative_fitness_distance over exactly batch_size sampled distinct-index pairs
losses.metric_pair_sampling: SplitMix64 seed metric_pair_seed XOR batch_size shifted left 32; sample ordered distinct indices with replacement across pairs
losses.decoder_freeze: all decoder-owned parameter gradients are exactly zero and decoder values, moments, and per-parameter Adam age are not advanced

checkpoint.parameter_state_hash: FNV-1a-64 over ordered names and IEEE-754 parameter bytes
checkpoint.replay_requirement: exact parameter hash, per-parameter Adam age, latent output, and reconstruction-loss replay

finite_difference_tests: four-head attention inputs and representative query, key, value, and output weights
64 to 256 to 64 FFN with residual and post-norm
L2-normalized metric-alignment loss with exactly batch-size sampled pairs
assembled total loss through encoder embedding and attention, latent projection, decoder memory, decoder cross-attention, decoder FFN and output, and both regression layers
required_runtime_tests: default 6 encoder plus 6 decoder forward smoke
tiny deterministic corpus reconstruction loss decrease
freeze then checkpoint then unfreeze exact replay with decoder Adam age unchanged while frozen
paper-scale profile declaration without executing the paper-scale run

claim_boundary: This commit verifies a pure C++ trainable mathematical kernel under declared missing-field completions. It does not admit the end-to-end M3 evolutionary method, unblock original taae, reproduce author results, or establish CPU or GPU performance.
